note: A call that gets most of the way: holds the price and finds the decider, but never puts a number on what the current process costs.

call.summary: Rep declined to discount and asked who else decides, but never quantified the cost of the status quo, so the CFO stayed on price.
evidence: Rep declined the discount and offered a shorter term instead.
Rep asked who else would be involved.
No figure was given for what the current process costs.

objections_raised: We're already looking at something that costs about half of that.
What kind of discount can you do if we sign this quarter?
structuredResult.strongest_moment: Refusing the discount without apologizing for the price.
structuredResult.weakest_moment: Answering the cheaper-competitor line with features instead of the cost of doing nothing.

transcriptTurns.text: Heads up, this is a simulated practice persona, not a real person. You have got ten minutes. What is the number?

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Twenty-eight hundred a month for the team plan. Before I get into what it does, can I ask how you handle this today?

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: We're already looking at something that costs about half of that.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: I have seen that one. The difference is the reconciliation step, which they leave to your team. Ours closes it automatically and the audit trail is built in.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Features. Everyone says features. What kind of discount can you do if we sign this quarter?

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: I cannot discount the seat price, and I would rather not, because then you would wonder what it was really worth. What I can do is a six-month term instead of twelve so the commitment is smaller.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Hm. Who else has signed off on this at other companies our size?

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Usually finance and whoever owns the close. Who else would be in the room on your side?

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Our controller, and eventually the CEO if it is over twenty-five hundred.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Then let me send something your controller can read in five minutes, and we can talk again once they have seen it.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Send it. I will book fifteen minutes next week if it holds up.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: It will be with you this afternoon. Thank you for the time.
